static_traits.name: Chen Nan
static_traits.family_status: Has a supportive family, but family may not fully understand the social difficulties brought by Asperger's
static_traits.social_status: Has difficulty building relationships with colleagues in the new job and often feels isolated
static_traits.medical_history: Asperger's syndrome; No major physical illness; never received specialized treatment for social difficulties
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly organized; tends toward literal understanding; easily overthinks others' intentions; tone somewhat negative but fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: Due to Asperger's, I tend to take things literally and have social difficulties. Recently I started a new Work, and today colleagues did not talk to me much, which makes me feel they look down on me.
basic_info.core_demands: The reason I seek counseling is that I have noticed social difficulties are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, especially in the new work environment.
growth_experiences: In previous Work environments, social misunderstandings caused by Asperger's repeatedly occurred, often coped with by shifting attention to tasks and Reduced socializing, limiting relationship building with colleagues.

core_beliefs: I have a fundamental flaw / am very strange
I am unable to fit in with others

special_situations.event: One day after starting a new job, colleagues rarely talk with him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not initiate conversation with me, it means they look down on me/think I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becoming quiet, reducing interaction in order to avoid making mistakes, and closely observing others' behavior to work out social cues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am a failure

special_situations.event: When colleagues joked, he did not understand it while everyone else laughed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot catch jokes or hints in time, I will be seen as strange and excluded
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overthinks conversation content; speaks cautiously to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am strange, they will avoid me

special_situations.event: Colleagues chatting among themselves without interacting with him, with ambiguous situations and others' behaviors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no clear positive response, it means they do not like me or are gossiping about me behind my back
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further Withdrawal, reducing participation in conversations to lower the risk of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not like me, and might talk about me behind my back

special_situations.event: Once helped a colleague complete a project and received their thanks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even occasional positive feedback is not enough to change others' overall view of me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or downplaying the importance of positive experiences, maintaining original negative beliefs to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just a coincidence; it does not mean they will like me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by peers and build stable, friendly interpersonal connections
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being mocked or looked down upon, worrying about being humiliated after exposing flaws
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes by staying quiet and reducing interaction
Excessive observation and Self-monitoring to control social risks
Shifts attention to tasks to avoid emotional contact

object_relations.self_representation: Someone who does not fit in, easily makes mistakes and is seen as 'weird'
object_relations.object_representation: A group of colleagues who are critical, judgmental, and may reject him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes challenging negative thoughts or suggests small behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing change is ineffective and others have already made negative judgments (worrying that trying will only bring greater disappointment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing doubt in a hesitant, low-energy tone, frequently using 'maybe/not necessarily/not useful', avoiding explicit commitment to change.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes that positive experience of helping a colleague and being thanked
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating the experience as incidental and unrepresentative, to avoid hoping for relationship improvement
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing in an objective, detached tone that 'the whole has not yet changed' and 'individual cases do not represent the whole', avoiding discussion of the positive emotional experience at the time.

manifestations: Feeling isolated in the new job due to misreading social cues
Worries colleagues gossip behind one's back, thinking oneself a 'failure/very strange'
Reducing interaction to avoid mistakes, further deepening the distance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: In session and work settings, cares excessively about others' opinions
Fearing saying the wrong thing and Suppressing expression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Repeatedly speculating during sessions that 'they look down on me/will gossip about me behind my back'
Attributing inner inferiority and Anxiety to others' negative evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Knows one wants to connect with colleagues, yet holds back what one wants to say in interactions
Chooses silence to avoid possible embarrassment or mistakes
Remaining restrained about trying new methods and Withdrawn during sessions

exception_events.target_problem: In social interactions at work, he usually becomes quiet and avoids conversation due to misreading cues, leading to more alienated relationships with colleagues
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once he took the initiative to help a colleague on a project and received thanks, experiencing a sense of being affirmed and connected at the time
exception_events.reason: Clue: took a different approach (proactively offering help on tasks), and received colleagues' positive feedback and thanks; the situation was task-centered with clear rules, reducing social ambiguity.

positive_force: Has task focus and competence, able to contribute value in task situations with clear rules
Has received positive feedback from colleagues in specific collaborations (being thanked)
Has a certain self-observation ability (able to notice one's tendency toward literal interpretation and misreading cues)
Family provides emotional support (though understanding is limited)
negative_force: Tends toward mind reading and hasty conclusions, amplifying potential negative evaluations from others
Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation, easily negating positive evidence
Asperger's causes difficulty decoding implicit social cues
Excessive Self-monitoring and avoidance, reducing actual interaction opportunities, maintaining isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Withdrawal in Work social situations, becoming Silent
antecedent: Colleagues chatting among themselves without interacting with him
Colleagues' behavior or feedback ambiguous and unclear
Worried about being judged or saying the wrong thing
Uncertain about meanings when encountering jokes or implicit social signals
target_behavior.core_reason: Difficulty decoding implicit social cues due to Asperger's, combined with the 'Being rejected/being looked down upon' core worry that catastrophically amplifies risk, thus using Withdrawal to relieve Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential embarrassment and Being rejected, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Further estrangement from colleagues, intensified Loneliness and Anxiety, Work performance affected

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently speculates about others' negative views (mind reading) and overthinks repeatedly
antecedent: Being ignored when others talk among themselves
Situations that are vague or lack positive signals
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth relying on external evaluation with the 'I am a failure/very strange' core belief, prompting mind-reading Interpretation of ambiguous cues
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and avoid social risk by predicting others' thoughts
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety maintained and escalated, further Avoiding interaction, Reinforcement of isolation and Self-denial
